title: Adversarial Review Report Metadata v1
description: Schema for the immutable target identity metadata block in an adversarial review report (issue #349, ADR-0027). The metadata block is YAML embedded in the report Markdown; this schema describes its parsed form. A report is STALE if head_sha or merge_base_sha no longer matches the branch's current state.

schema_version.description: Schema identifier. Must equal exactly this string.

merge_base_sha.description: Output of `git merge-base HEAD <base-branch>` at the time the review was conducted.

head_sha.description: Output of `git rev-parse HEAD` on the reviewed branch at review time.

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw output of `git diff <merge_base_sha>..<head_sha>`. Used to detect stale reports when the diff changes after the review.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this report was first published.

skill_version.description: Git commit SHA or `git describe` output of skills/adversarial-review/ at review time. Allows pinning the protocol version used.

reviewer_run_ids.description: Identity-ledger run_ids of the two Phase 1 reviewers. Used to trace reviewer identities back to the ledger.

reviewer_a.description: run_id from the identity ledger for Reviewer A.

reviewer_b.description: run_id from the identity ledger for Reviewer B.

x-stale-judgement-rules: A report is STALE when head_sha != git rev-parse HEAD on the branch.
A report is STALE when merge_base_sha != git merge-base HEAD <base-branch>.
A report is STALE when diff_sha256 != sha256(git diff merge_base_sha..head_sha).
A STALE report MUST NOT satisfy Adversarial-Lane: fired in the PR body.
A STALE report MAY be kept with a [STALE — superseded by <path>] notice.
